what_this_is: The address rules alone, with no page opened and no list used, on links reported as phishing that day. Holds counts only.
caveats: One day's feed. Many links can share one host, and this feed is a small sample of phishing.
This measures missed phishing only. False alarms on ordinary sites are measured only on the small hand-written set.
The rules recognise 14 brands by address, and phishing hosted on an ordinary-looking address shows no address sign.
